facts.text: "Only one man ever got out of here. Now he has to get back in. Eat up."
facts.why: Goodspeed never says this. It is in quote marks and signed Stanley Goodspeed, so it reads as a film line. The fact is right, since Mason is the only man to escape Alcatraz, but the words are not in the film. A real Mason line is below. I could not open a quote page, so this is from memory.
facts.fix: Welcome to the Rock. (sign it John Mason)
